headline: How much longer will something keep blocking my money?
note:
FRAME: money — the strictest guard on the funnel. No amount, no date, no source, no financial advice, never blames her, never 'too late', never presumes she is broke.

🔴 Beat 4 says the money has not LANDED or not STAYED — never that she has none. Her own ad asserts the block, so restating it is her premise, not our claim.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE. The six beats never need it; naming an inheritance is the shortest path to the authorship ban.

FINDING: 'a block does not run down, it gets moved' — beats 5a and 5b.

🔴 She asks HOW LONG. No duration may be given, forward or back — 'not much longer' is a length, and a length is the gap that caught the soulmate age band. The read answers the SHAPE of the question instead: a block is not a timer, so the number she wants does not exist.

a: You turned the Magician. You had nothing to go on, and your hand found the worker of the three.
Look at his hands. Both of them are busy, and neither is idle.
You asked how much longer something will keep blocking your money. I keep going back to those two hands, both of them busy.
Still, it hasn't landed. And what you want from me is a number.
Something turns up at the point where it would come through. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing the holding…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing showed through, and yours was the one held by a single rope.
Look at the rope. One ankle, and nothing else on him.
You asked how much longer something will keep blocking your money. One rope keeps this whole picture still.
And yet it hasn't landed. And you're asking me how long that lasts.
The hold is constant, and it doesn't ease at any point. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and you took the one travelling light.
Look at the bundle on his stick. That's all he's carrying.
You asked how much longer something will keep blocking your money. A start, and how little it needs — that's what I'm looking at.
But it still hasn't landed. And you're the one asking how much longer.
Something sits right where the money would land. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
